verdicts.title: The Simplicial EHP Sequence in A1-Algebraic Topology
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: We give a tool for understanding simplicial desuspension in A1-algebraic topology: we show that $X \to Ω(S^1 \wedge X)\to Ω(S^1 \wedge X \wedge X)$ is a fiber sequence up to homotopy in 2-localized A1-algebraic topology for $X = (S^1)^m \wedge G_m^{\wedge q}$ with $m>1$. It follows that there is an EHP sequence spectral sequence $$Z_{(2)} \otimes π_{n+1+i}^{A1} (S^{2n+2m+1} \wedge (G_m)^{\wedge 2q}) \Rightarrow Z_{(2)} \otimes π_{i}^{A1, s} (S^{m} \wedge (G_m)^{\wedge q}).$$
verdicts.judge_reasoning: The abstract concerns the EHP fiber sequence and a spectral sequence in A1-algebraic topology for specific motivic spheres, with no mention of CNF formulas, satisfiability, or simplicial generator bounds. It shares only the broad vocabulary of 'simplicial' with the conjecture.

verdicts.title: A new quantum computational set-up for algebraic topology via simplicial sets
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: In this paper, a quantum computational framework for algebraic topology based on simplicial set theory is presented. This extends previous work, which was limited to simplicial complexes and aimed mostly to topological data analysis.
